title: Juicy Herbal Korean Chocolate Hwajeon
description: A diabetic-friendly Korean dish featuring dark chocolate and herbal flavors, perfect for a hangover cure. This hwajeon is juicy, caramelized, and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour, coconut sugar, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, unsweetened almond milk, and vegetable oil.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Melt the dark chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Fold the melted chocolate into the batter until well combined.
Stir in the crushed ginseng, dried green tea leaves, and korean chili flakes.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into small balls and flatten slightly into disks.
Place the hwajeon on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each cookie.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
